data_fields.name: flash_restart_on_hit
data_fields.donor_constant: interrupt = true (default) for hits; false for drowning

best_idea: A landed hit restarts a full-screen flash that fades linearly to clear over 0.5 s, while a per-tick damage effect is ignored until the running flash ends.
decision_why: The restart-on-hit and skip-on-tick rule is the idea worth keeping; Frankendom must trigger it from the server-confirmed hit event with a hit-or-tick tag, which the donor does not have, and expose the peak alpha as data because a fixed 100 percent flash can hide the target at 375 wide.
acceptance: In a duel the player's screen flashes on the frame a server-confirmed hit arrives; a second confirmed hit within 0.5 s restarts it; a burn tick while it runs does not; the overlay alpha at 0.25 s after a hit is 0.5 at any frame rate.
